currency_assumptions: Venue prices are researched and stored in JPY (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = JPY). The soft budget and every USD figure use the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = JPY 174.81, giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the derived cross rate and three hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes a 09:00-17:00 package, that package is the recorded amount; where it publishes only blocks (午前/午後 or 9:00-12:00/13:00-17:00), the recorded amount is the published sum or the published continuous-use rate for those blocks, and the twelve-hour figure is stated inside evidence.observed_facts rather than folded into the headline number.

Where a venue publishes only an hourly rate, the recorded amount is that rate multiplied by 8 hours and the record carries cost_basis estimated_from_rate with a final-quote question. Where no readable price exists, estimated_cost_usd is null with a cost_unknown question.

declared_gaps.text: Two of the eighteen rooms carry no USD figure — Impact Hub Kyoto (its live fee page returned HTTP 000 on four attempts; only a 2025-02-17 archive is readable) and THE TERMINAL KYOTO (no hire price published) — so their cost is unknown rather than zero. Four more publish a room rate without AV or catering terms (ハートンホテル京都 嵐山 and 宇治伏見, KRP ルーム2, 京都大学 国際交流ホール I) and each carries a final-quote question. Sixteen USD figures use ECB 2026-11-27 (1 JPY = USD 0.00626795).

Each of the eighteen room records rests on a single operator or city page for its capacity, rate, hours and equipment; no second independent source was found for any room, and every record is marked needs_human_verify with its own verification questions.

Four of the eighteen rooms carry no room photograph and keep a withheld record with the reason: kokoka セミナー室 (the captured facility page only illustrates イベントホール・特別会議室・第1/第2会議室・第3/第4会議室・研究室・和風別館・交流サロン), the two ハートピア京都 rooms (the fee page carries only banners and the convention index returned HTTP 403), and FabCafe Kyoto 2F 和室 (the captured meeting-space page renders site flags and CSS backgrounds, with no room photograph identified). The other fourteen rooms carry 22 hotlinked operator photographs with rights recorded. No Wikimedia image was used: no Commons file on a captured page depicts one of these hired rooms.

Fourteen rooms publish a hire interval that covers the paired 09:00-21:00 Saturday programme (kokoka ×4 to 21:00, ハートピア ×2 in three blocks to 21:00, みやこめっせ 09:00-22:00 building access with a night block to 21:00, アスニー ×2 to 21:00 except Sundays and public holidays, エルシエント to 21:00, ハートンホテル ×2 09:00-22:00, KRP day+night blocks to 21:00, 京都大学 to 21:30). One room, 京都府立京都学・歴彩館, publishes 09:00-21:00 on weekdays but closes at 17:00 on Saturdays and Sundays and is closed on public holidays, so only the 8-hour floor is evidenced there. Three rooms publish no hire window at all (Impact Hub Kyoto, THE TERMINAL KYOTO 09:00-18:00 daily hours only, FabCafe Kyoto refers to the shop calendar), so their twelve-hour fit is unknown.

The three local-requirement claims record the national and Kyoto rules for language, alcohol and food. They do not say which licence a given venue holds, whether a 50-person private event is covered, or who would hold it: alcohol service and external catering stay unknown on every room, and one room (京都アスニー 第2・第3研修室) is recorded as prohibiting alcohol by its own published rule.

Twelve 2027 calendar rows were merged from the approved bundle; the page recommends no date and none is booked. IVS 2027 is not in the array because the organiser site still presents IVS2026 and no 2027 edition page exists. Related-event coverage is thin: two of the twelve rows are AI-relevant (AI博覧会 Osaka 2027 and Japan IT Week 関西 2027, both outside Kyoto) and the other ten are logistics-only city events.

The five programme-wide mandatory discovery sources (Miragather ×3, AI Tinkerers, the DeAI Luma feed) carry no check date in this store: the Kyoto research bundle recorded no pass against them, and the page prints that fact rather than an assumed read.

All eighteen records are building tier: the point is the building that houses the room, taken from the saved GSI address-search response for the block address, and no room entrance was verified. Twelve distinct points carry eighteen records because kokoka (×4), ハートピア (×2), アスニー (×2) and ハートンホテル (×2) each place several rooms in one building.

Reiwa 9 (Apr 2027–Mar 2028): no citywide kindergarten dates verified for year-start, summer, winter or year-end. The first three 2027 spans are Rule No. 5 defaults, not annual dates; March 2028 is outside the display year.

Reiwa 9: no citywide elementary year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. Apr 1–7, 2027 is the rule default only; the Reiwa 8 notice set Apr 1–9 in 2026, not 2027. Summer and winter are principal-set; March 2028 is outside the display year.

Reiwa 9: no citywide junior-high year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. Apr 1–7, 2027 is the rule default only. Summer and winter are principal-set; March 2028 is outside the display year. Confirm school-specific variations, including Saikyo affiliated and Rakufu two-term calendars; their Reiwa 8 exception table does not specify year-end dates.

Reiwa 9: no citywide integrated-school year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. The rule leaves dates to principals using elementary or junior-high schedules as a guide. The Reiwa 8 notice's cross-reference to junior high does not establish Reiwa 9 dates.

No dated 2027 city high-school or support-school year-start, summer, autumn (where applicable), winter or year-end closures verified. City high-school Art. 6 gives principal-set windows, not closures throughout those windows. Neither the kindergarten-to-junior-high notice nor the prefectural rule establishes these dates.
Prefectural-school spans are Article 7 defaults for prefecturally administered schools only. School-specific and approved exceptions were not verified; do not apply to municipal or private schools.

Circular 0018/2026 does not standardise summer or local discretionary days. February 18–19, 2027 is the common closure; the longer February 15–19 post-primary break can be shortened and primary schools can opt in. Easter can be shortened by primary schools under contingency arrangements.

Summer is the pupil interval between the June 30 administrative day and September 7 opening, not a named break in the calendars. December winter break is shown as printed; statutory/observed holidays and weekends outside the named break are not extended into it.

Summer is between the June 2 and August 16 instruction boundaries, not a named district closure; some early education sites remain open during recess. This scope covers district calendar breaks, not every non-instructional date or site-specific schedule.
Council pupil dates verified for the stored recesses; staff days and any school-specific divergence are not a separate school-break census.
Statewide breaks checked against Berlin ICS and KMK tables; individual school exceptions are not verified.

evidence.inference: Golden Week is the busiest domestic travel period of the Japanese year and hotel demand, train load and tourist crowding across Kyoto peak sharply, so venue and accommodation planning for any date inside 29 April-5 May 2027 must assume holiday-period transport and hotel pressure.
evidence.observed_facts: The Cabinet Office national holiday page (https://www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/gaiyou.html, fetched 2026-11-28 and captured as captures/cao_shukujitsu_2027.html) prints the 2027 block under the heading 「〇令和9年（2027年）の国民の祝日・休日」, listing 昭和の日 on 4月29日, 憲法記念日 on 5月3日, みどりの日 on 5月4日 and こどもの日 on 5月5日. The same four dates are stored in the plan-event holiday registry under edition 「令和9年（2027年）の国民の祝日・休日（内閣府）」 with per-row locators of the form 見出し「〇令和9年（2027年）の国民の祝日・休日」、行「昭和の日／4月29日」 (and the equivalent rows for 憲法記念日／5月3日, みどりの日／5月4日, こどもの日／5月5日). This record spans 29 April to 5 May 2027 so that the four holiday dates sit inside one holiday-period row. No other date in that span is asserted as a holiday.

evidence.observed_facts: Appendix A closes all primary schools on Thursday 18 and Friday 19 February 2027 and all post-primary schools from Monday 15 to Friday 19 February 2027. Primary schools may use three discretionary days to extend the break to 15-19 February 2027, so only the two days on which every school closes are recorded as the standardised common break.

evidence.observed_facts: The BMB page states 'Die Tage vom 27. Oktober bis 31. Oktober werden gesetzlich als Herbstferien festgelegt.'; in 2027 that span is Wednesday 27 October to Sunday 31 October. The page names an opt-out ordinance for Bildungsdirektionen in special cases; no Vienna opt-out is published on the directorate page, and school-autonomous days are separate per-school days, so the statutory span is recorded. The page anchors the rule in 'Schulzeitgesetz 1985, BGBl. I Nr. 77/1985'; the § 2 Abs 4 Z 8 wording was read from the RIS consolidated text through the search backend's fetch because direct access to ris.bka.gv.at answers HTTP 503 from the curation host.

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3 makes 24 December to 6 January the statutory Christmas school-free period in every year; in 2027/28 that is Friday 24 December 2027 to Thursday 6 January 2028. The optional 23 December extension applies only when 23 December is a Monday (it is a Thursday in 2027), and no ordinance declaring 23 December 2027 or 7 January 2028 free is published, so the statutory span is recorded. The Vienna 2027/28 school-year edition is not published, so this row rests on the statute alone.

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 2 declares 'der Allerseelentag' school-free, and the BMB page lists 'der Allerseelentag (2. November)' under 'Schulfrei sind - abgesehen von den Sonntagen -'. The date is fixed at 2 November in every year, so the 2027 occurrence is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Allerseelen is not one of Austria's statutory public holidays (the AT public layer carries the thirteen gesetzliche Feiertage and none falls on 2 November), so the day is recorded here as a school_holiday row. The Vienna directorate 2026/2027 page lists the same date in its 'Schulfreie Tage' section for 2026 ('Allerheiligen, Allerseelen: Sonntag, 1. November und Montag, 2. November 2026'), confirming that Vienna observes it. Direct access to ris.bka.gv.at from the curation host answers HTTP 503, so the wording was read through the search backend's fetch of the consolidated page https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10009575. That page's 'Fassung vom' header label was not stable across fetches on 2026-11-20 (21.10.2026, 18.11.2026 and 19.11.2026 were each printed by a fetch of the same URL), so this row cites the statute by Gesetzesnummer and asserts no Fassung date.

evidence.observed_facts: The school-year regulation fixes the winter Christmas break as 23–31 December in every year, with an earlier 22 December start only when 22 December is a Monday. In 2027/28 22 December is a Wednesday, so the statutory span is Thursday 23 December to Friday 31 December 2027. The full MEN 2027/2028 calendar is not published; the only 2027/2028 item on the ministry's calendar index is the winter-break announcement, which places mazowieckie on 31 January–13 February 2028, outside this window.

evidence.observed_facts: The MŠMT 2026/2027 edition prints 'Vánoční prázdniny začínají ve středu 23. prosince 2026 a končí v neděli 3. ledna 2027.' and names Monday 4 January 2027 as the day teaching resumes. The row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. Vyhláška 16/2005 Sb. § 4 odst. 3 fixes the break as 23 December to 2 January inclusive with an end extension only when 3 January is a Friday; in 2026/27 2 January is a Saturday, so the ministry's stated Sunday end adds only the weekend day on which no teaching takes place.

evidence.observed_facts: The Board paper for 第7回教育委員会 (16 June 2020) prints the 大阪市立学校管理規則 (昭和35年大阪市教育委員会規則第7号) text at 第2条の2第1項: 「(1) 夏季休業日 7月21日から8月24日(高等学校においては8月31日)まで」「(2) 冬季休業日 12月25日から翌年1月7日まで」「(3) 春季休業日 3月25日(高等学校においては3月16日)から4月7日まで」「(4) その他教育委員会が特に必要と認める日」. The 令和4年4月1日 amendment (第5回教育委員会 議案第35号, https://www.city.osaka.lg.jp/kyoiku/cmsfiles/contents/0000563/563070/giann35.pdf) dropped the 高等学校 parentheticals from items (1) and (3) when the city high schools transferred to Osaka Prefecture and carried item (2) forward unchanged (printed ［(2) 略］ in its 改正前/改正後 table), so the 冬季休業日 bound is unchanged. The 2026/2027 winter break therefore runs 2026-12-25 to 2027-01-07; the row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start.

evidence.observed_facts: The 第5回教育委員会 paper (令和4年3月24日, 議案第35号) prints the 改正後 text of 第2条の2第1項 for the 大阪市立学校管理規則: 「(1) 夏季休業日 ７月21日から８月24日まで」「(3) 春季休業日 ３月25日から４月７日まで」, with the pre-amendment 改正前 column carrying 「３月25日（高等学校においては３月16日）から４月７日まで」. The 高等学校 parenthetical was removed because the city's high schools transferred to Osaka Prefecture on 令和4年4月1日, so the single 市立 bound for kindergartens, elementary schools, junior high schools and compulsory-education schools is 25 March to 7 April. 第2条の2第2項 lets a principal set different holidays with Board approval and 第2条の2第1項第4号 lets the Board designate further days, so the row is the rule's default and carries a verification question.

evidence.observed_facts: Section 4 of Bank of Thailand notice 37/2569, headed 「วันหยุดตามประเพณีของสถาบันการเงินและสถาบันการเงินเฉพาะกิจ ประจำปี พ.ศ. 2570」, prints item 17 as 「วันศุกร์ที่ 10 ธันวาคม วันรัฐธรรมนูญ」. Section 3 applies the notice to every financial institution and specialised financial institution under the Financial Institution Business Act, and section 2 grounds it in sections 37 and 120/1 of that Act, so the list is the Bangkok-applicable bank holiday list; no other date is printed for this holiday.

additional_sources.source_title: 国税庁 お酒に関するQ&A（よくある質問）【販売業免許関係】Q3

alcohol.quote: 博覧会場等で臨時に販売場を設けて酒類の小売を行う場合には、期限を付した酒類小売業免許を申請し、取得していただく必要があります。 … 期限付酒類小売業免許を受けるためには、原則として、販売場を開設する日の２週間前までに申請する必要がありますが、一定の要件を満たす場合には、販売場を開設する日の10日前までに届け出ることで、期限付酒類小売業免許を受けたものとして取り扱うこととしています。 … 博覧会場等で臨時に酒類を販売するときは、以下の判定表で各項目を御確認いただき、臨時販売場の 所在地の所轄税務署 に、申請書又は届出書を提出してください。 … 届出をする者が、酒類製造者又は酒類販売業者であること … 博覧会場等（届出者又は届出者と密接な関係にある者が催物等の主催者として管理、運営していない場所（施設、建物等を含む）に限る）で臨時に販売場を設け酒類の小売を行う場合であること … 酒場、料理店その他酒類を専ら自己の営業場で飲用に供する業を行う場合には、販売業免許は必要ありませんが、例えばテイクアウト用など、その営業場以外の場所で飲用に供されるための酒類を販売する場合には、酒税法に基づき、販売場ごとにその販売場の所在地の所轄税務署長から販売業免許を受ける必要があります。
alcohol.source_locator: captures/claim_alcohol_nta_limited_retail.html — 国税庁 期限付酒類小売業免許について, the lead sentence, the two-week / ten-day sentence, the 所轄税務署 filing sentence and 要件 2 and 3; captures/claim_alcohol_nta_qa03.html — 国税庁 お酒に関するQ&A【販売業免許関係】Q3, the whole answer sentence. The 所轄税務署 phrase and the two 要件 lines are page text or list markup, so those segments were matched after tag stripping; the paragraph quotes are raw substrings of the saved bytes (both 国税庁 pages are Shift_JIS and the saved bytes were decoded before matching). The two pages print no 管轄区域 table, so the claim assigns no ward or venue to a particular 税務署.
alcohol.source_title: 国税庁 期限付酒類小売業免許について; 国税庁 お酒に関するQ&A（よくある質問）【販売業免許関係】Q3

value.authority: 国税庁（酒税法）— the 期限付酒類小売業免許 route for a temporary 販売場 set up at a 博覧会場等, and the 販売業免許 rule for selling alcohol from a 販売場.
value.competent_desk: The competent desk is the 所轄税務署 for the venue's address — 臨時販売場の所在地の所轄税務署 for a temporary point, 販売場の所在地の所轄税務署長 for a 販売業免許 — to be confirmed per venue. The quoted pages print no 管轄区域 table and establish no ward-to-office assignment.
value.hired_room_scope: A hired hall is not the organiser's own 営業場, so the Q3 exemption does not settle alcohol at a rented venue, and nothing on these two pages addresses a private, invitation-only event in a hired room.
value.licence_by_activity: A 期限付き酒類小売業免許 covers a temporary 販売場 set up at a 博覧会場等, and a 販売業免許 from the 販売場の所在地の所轄税務署長, one per 販売場, covers selling alcohol from a 販売場; Q3's exemption from 販売業免許 covers only a 酒場・料理店 serving alcohol 専ら自己の営業場.
value.not_established: The pages do not say who holds the licence for a 50-person private event — whether the venue, the caterer or the organiser — or which 税務署 covers a given venue address. They also do not say whether complimentary drinks with no sale need any licence, whether a private invitation-only event is a 博覧会場等 for this rule, what the fees and processing time are, or what a hotel's or caterer's existing licence covers at a hired venue.
value.notification_route_scope: The ten-day 届出 route is open only where the filer is a 酒類製造者又は酒類販売業者 and the venue is one that the filer, or a party closely related to the filer, does not manage or operate as the event organiser; its other printed 要件 include an event of seven days or less (or wholly/mostly ticketed), alcohol retail not the event's main purpose, dates fixed in advance, the sales point identified in the venue contract, the same product range as the filer's licence, and no delivery away from the event site.
value.on_premises_rule_scope: Q3 answers only for a 酒場・料理店 serving alcohol 専ら自己の営業場: serving it there for drinking on those premises needs no 販売業免許, while selling alcohol for drinking away from those premises needs a 販売業免許 from the 所轄税務署長, one per 販売場.
value.quoted_rule_scope: 国税庁 states that setting up a temporary 販売場 at a 博覧会場等 to sell alcohol at retail requires a 期限を付した酒類小売業免許 (期限付酒類小売業免許), applied for in principle at least two weeks before the sales point opens, or notified at least ten days before when the printed 要件 are met, filed with 臨時販売場の所在地の所轄税務署.
value.selling_needs_licence: Selling alcohol at the event — a cash or ticket bar included — is a 酒類の小売, and the 販売業免許 rule printed in Q3 is the one that governs selling from a 販売場. Whether a private event inside a hired hall is a 博覧会場等 is not established by these pages.
value.who_must_hold_it: In the authority's own terms it is held by the filer or the seller: the ten-day 届出 route requires the filer to be a 酒類製造者又は酒類販売業者, and the 販売業免許 route names the person selling from the 販売場.

food.quote: 飲食店（レストラン、カフェ、バーなど）を営業したり、食品を製造、加工販売（鮮魚介類、生肉など）するには、食品衛生法に基づく許可が必要です。 … 新たに営業許可を受ける手続きのおよその流れは次のとおりです。 … 事前相談 → 電子又は窓口申請 → 審査（書類審査・実地調査） → 許可 … 営業の種類によって施設基準が定められています。 … 施設の工事着工前に施設の図面を持参し医療衛生センターで、事前相談することをおすすめします。
food.source_locator: captures/claim_food_kyoto_kyoka.html — 京都市 営業許可申請方法, section 新たに営業許可を受けるには（新規）: the 飲食店 licence sentence, the 手続きのおよその流れ sentence with its 事前相談 → 電子又は窓口申請 → 審査（書類審査・実地調査） → 許可 line, and step 1 事前相談 with the 施設基準 sentence and the 医療衛生センター sentence. Text matched after tag stripping and whitespace normalisation; the 医療衛生センター mentions elsewhere on the page are link markup.
food.source_title: 京都市 営業許可申請方法 (ページ番号82748, updated 2026年7月7日)

value.authority: 京都市保健所; the licence counter is 京都市医療衛生センター, reached through the 食品衛生申請等システム or in person
value.event_route: Not established by this page: it publishes the fixed-premises 営業許可 route and says nothing about a 臨時営業 licence or 臨時出店 notification for a one-off event, so no event-food route is asserted for Kyoto.
value.fixed_premises: 京都市 states that running a 飲食店 (restaurant, cafe, bar) or manufacturing and processing food for sale needs a 食品衛生法 営業許可, and prints the flow as 事前相談 → 電子又は窓口申請 → 審査（書類審査・実地調査） → 許可.
value.licence: 食品衛生法に基づく営業許可（飲食店営業を含む）
value.not_established: These pages do not say who holds the licence for a private event (caterer or organiser), whether a member-only event needs any notification at all, what the fee and lead time are, or whether a hotel or venue kitchen licence covers catering into a hired room; those stay venue-level questions.

language.quote: 「やさしい日本語」 とは 難しい単語 や 表現を 使わない 日本語のこと です。 … このページでは 外国人の方、 障害のある方 など にも 分かりやすい 言葉で 京都市の 暮らしに 役立つ 情報 や 防災情報 を 書いています。
language.source_locator: captures/claim_language_kyoto_yasashii.html — the 「やさしい日本語」 とは definition sentence and the following このページでは… sentence under the page heading 生活ガイドブック（やさしい日本語版）総合目次 (ページ番号250837, 2019年4月26日); the language row (English 한글 中文簡体 中文繁體 やさしい日本語) in the page header; and the お問い合わせ先 footer naming 京都市 総合企画局市長公室広報担当. The sentences were matched after tag stripping and whitespace normalisation, so the spaces inside the quoted Japanese are the page's furigana markup and not typos; the language row is link markup, matched the same way.
language.source_title: 京都市 生活ガイドブック（やさしい日本語版）総合目次 (ページ番号250837, 2019年4月26日)

value.authority: 京都市 総合企画局市長公室広報担当 (the contact printed on the page)
value.city_guidance: 京都市 defines 「やさしい日本語」 as Japanese that does not use difficult words or expressions, and publishes its 生活ガイドブック in that register for 外国人の方、障害のある方など — it adjusts the Japanese to the reader instead of assuming one register reaches everyone.
value.event_implication: For a private community event this is guidance, not an obligation: the city publishes no rule requiring a private event to use any particular language. Copy in plain Japanese with an English version follows the city's own practice; it is not a legal requirement.
value.not_established: The page sets no obligation on a private event's language, gives no figure for which languages Kyoto residents understand, and does not address interpretation or signage at a hired venue.
value.published_channels: The same page header offers English, 한국어, 中文简体 and 中文繁體 versions alongside やさしい日本語, so the city's own published answer to a non-Japanese-speaking resident is a translated page plus adjusted Japanese.

verification_questions: Confirm the 大会議室 fee row (the room page prints 12,650 / 18,920 / 19,030 yen blocks and 31,570 / 37,950 / 50,600 yen packages against the 182 m2 room; confirm these are the general-public rates and not a linked-equipment surcharge).
Confirm Saturday availability and the application route (counter reception 09:00-17:00 on weekdays, or the online reservation system).
Confirm catering and alcohol policy for a community event (the price page prints no catering rule).

evidence.inference: The room is 2.4x the target attendance at its lower capacity bound, so the scorer will flag oversized_capacity; it is retained because a 49,500 yen 09:00-17:00 package with a 12-hour option is the strongest public-hall fallback in the set.
evidence.observed_facts: The Heartpia Kyoto fee page (fetched 2026-11-28) lists 大会議室 at 120-200 seats with blocks 25,340 / 29,650 / 33,830 yen, continuous 午前・午後 49,500 yen, 午後・夜間 57,140 yen and 終日 79,940 yen. The page notes that 大会議室 and 視聴覚室 have different installed equipment and require the loudspeaker system (拡声装置 1,850 yen per block); 大会議室 takes four wireless plus four wired microphones. Hall lighting (upper/lower horizon, suspension, spot) is available for a fee. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: Marutamachi (丸太町) on the Karasuma subway line, connected directly to the building underground (the fee page's own banner reads 地下鉄丸太町駅直結, captured as captures/heartpia_fee.html); no surface walking time is published because the link is direct.

verification_questions: Confirm screen and projector for 120-seat staging (the page prices a video projector at 4,760 yen per block and a loudspeaker system at 1,850 yen; the hall's own screen is not itemised).
Confirm Wi-Fi in 大会議室.
Confirm the tax treatment of the 49,500 yen 午前・午後 rate.
Confirm Saturday availability; the hall is heavily booked by welfare and public-interest users.

Confirm the alcohol rule for 大会議室: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the fee page publishes no alcohol rule and the building's welfare-purpose terms may restrict it.

evidence.inference: The 100-seat school layout doubles the target attendance, so the scorer will flag oversized_capacity; the split-hall option is the practical lever for a 50-person event and is carried as a verification question rather than priced.
evidence.observed_facts: The Hearton Hotel Kyoto hall page (fetched 2026-11-28) lists 宇治伏見 on the first floor as the combined 宇治 + 伏見 hall: 100 three-seat school desks, 68 two-seat, 180 theatre, 54 hollow-square, priced at 66,000 yen for 1-3 hours, 83,000 for 4, 100,000 for 5, 117,000 for 6, 134,000 for 7-8 hours, 151,000 for 9, 168,000 for 10 hours and more, 17,000 yen per overtime hour, plus a 3,300 yen per day night surcharge for 19:00-22:00, all tax-inclusive. The page states 宇治 and 伏見 can be used separately. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. verification_questions: Confirm AV for a 50-person talk in the 180-theatre / 100-school hall (room hire only is published).

evidence.inference: This is the best-evidenced room in the set for streaming (LAN, Wi-Fi and stated online-streaming support) and the only candidate that explicitly grants outside food in a designated area, but the Saturday 17:00 closure rules out the preferred 12-hour window and the purpose restriction is a material eligibility question.
evidence.observed_facts: The Kyoto Prefectural Library and Archives hall guide PDF (fetched 2026-11-28) gives the 小ホール as 198.84 m2 with 100 movable seats (half-room use possible), wired LAN and Wi-Fi available, and online-streaming support, with a paid video projector. The fee table prices 午前 15,300 yen, 午後 20,400 yen, 夜間 22,950 yen, 午前・午後 32,200 yen (a 10% discount on the two blocks), 午後・夜間 39,100 yen and 全日 52,800 yen. The guide states that on Saturdays and Sundays the building closes at 17:00 so the night block cannot be used, that public holidays are closure days, and that hall use is limited to lectures and seminars related to Kyoto's history and culture; performances (興行), sales, and noise-generating activity are refused. Wi-Fi is also available through the public Japan.Free Wi-Fi KYOTO service per the site FAQ. verification_questions: Confirm purpose eligibility: the guide restricts hall use to lectures and seminars connected with Kyoto's history and culture under the facility's founding purpose (京都の歴史や文化に関わる講演会やセミナー等), so an AI×Web3 community day must be accepted by the operator before the venue can be used.
Confirm that Saturday 09:00-17:00 is available and that the hall is not closed for a public holiday on the chosen weekend (public holidays are closure days).
Confirm the tax treatment of the 32,200 yen two-block rate.
Confirm the equipment fee for the video projector, screen and wireless microphones (the guide prices these separately; one wireless hand microphone is free).

Confirm the alcohol rule for 小ホール: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the hall guide publishes no alcohol rule, and the venue's history-and-culture purpose may restrict it.

evidence.inference: 54 claimed seats with a 36,190 yen all-day rate make this the cheapest 12-hour-capable Kyoto candidate found; the 09:00-17:00 figure of 22,390 yen is the continuous two-block discount rather than the sum of the two blocks (24,870 yen), which is how the page's own 連続利用 table reads.
evidence.observed_facts: The Heartpia Kyoto fee page (heartpia-kyoto.jp/convention/fee.html, fetched 2026-11-28) defines three daily blocks (午前 9:00-12:00, 午後 13:00-17:00, 夜間 18:00-21:00) and a continuous-use table. 第5会議室 is listed at 54 seats with blocks 11,500 / 13,370 / 15,340 yen and continuous rates 午前・午後 22,390 yen, 午後・夜間 25,840 yen, 終日 36,190 yen. The page prices a video projector at 4,760 yen per block, a loudspeaker system at 1,850 yen, microphones at 1,500 yen and a CD player at 1,850 yen; 第3-5会議室 carry two wireless plus two wired microphones. Closure is 28 December to 4 January only, and keys are handed over 10 minutes before the booked time. Address 375 Shimizu-cho, Takeyamachi-dori Karasuma-higashi-iru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto 604-0874. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: Marutamachi (丸太町) on the Karasuma subway line, connected directly to the building underground (the fee page's own banner reads 地下鉄丸太町駅直結, captured as captures/heartpia_fee.html); no surface walking time is published because the link is direct.

verification_questions: Confirm the projector arrangement: the page prices a video projector at 4,760 yen per block as an optional item and does not list a built-in screen, so confirm both a 4:3/16:9 screen and projector for slides.
Confirm Wi-Fi in 第5会議室 (the fee page lists audio, projection and lighting equipment only).
Confirm whether the printed 22,390 yen 午前・午後 rate is tax-inclusive (the page prints no consumption-tax statement).
Confirm Saturday availability and the application route (counter or telephone reservation, six months ahead).

Confirm the alcohol rule for 第5会議室: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the fee page publishes no alcohol rule and the building's welfare-purpose terms may restrict it.

evidence.inference: Fifty seats exactly meets the target attendance with no headroom, and the page's explicit 'no monitor' statement makes the room screen-poor for a projector-led AI event; it is retained because the price is the lowest of the kokoka set and the screen question is soft.
evidence.observed_facts: The kokoka fee table (fetched 2026-11-28) lists the Seminar Room as 50 seats over 98 m2, 'for all kind of seminars', with free audio-visual facilities (DVD players, VCRs) and the warning that 'the monitor is not available'. Saturday/Sunday/holiday blocks are 11,200 yen (9:00-12:00) and 15,900 yen (13:00-17:00), i.e. 27,100 yen for 09:00-17:00 and 41,400 yen for 09:00-21:00. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: Keage (蹴上) on the Tozai subway line, about 6 minutes on foot (kokoka access page https://www.kcif.or.jp/web/jp/access/, captured as captures/kokoka_access.html: '京都市営地下鉄の最寄り駅から徒歩6分', and the same page's taxi instruction names 蹴上).

Confirm that the 2025-02-17 Internet Archive snapshot still describes the current offer (2F 会所 180 m2, 60-90 seats at weekends, free projector, screen, microphones and PA with reservation), since the live page could not be read today.
Confirm event Wi-Fi in the 2F 会所 space (the 2025 snapshot advertises a comfortable network in the coworking area and free projectors, screen, microphones and PA with reservation).
Confirm date availability directly with the Impact Hub Kyoto office.

Confirm the alcohol rule for the 2F 会所: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the 2025 archive page publishes no alcohol rule and the live page could not be read today.

The combined 09:00-17:00 figure recorded here is 27,600 yen for both rooms; three blocks for both rooms would be 42,400 yen for 09:00-21:00. names_seen: kokoka 京都市国際交流会館 — Conference Rooms 1 + 2（第1・第2会議室 連結）
verification_questions: Confirm that both rooms are free on the target Saturday and can be joined by removing the partition (the page states the partition can be removed but not that both rooms can be held together).
Confirm AV for a talk: the page sells equipment separately and lists no projector in the rooms.
Confirm event Wi-Fi in the conference rooms.
Confirm the tax treatment of the 27,600 yen combined Saturday rate.
Confirm Saturday availability for 2027 through the online reservation system.

Confirm the alcohol rule for Conference Rooms 1 + 2: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the venue publishes no alcohol permission, and an in-house cafe's licence is not evidence that a rented room may serve alcohol.

evidence.inference: Capacity 130 is the venue's own flat-floor figure rather than a seating count, so a 50-person event has headroom; the same page prices the block structure, so the cost is a published rate for the 09:00-17:00 package and the 12-hour figure is stated in evidence rather than claimed as a booking.
evidence.observed_facts: The kokoka Kyoto International Community House 'Venues for Hire' page (kcif.or.jp/web/en/facilityrental/facility, fetched 2026-11-28) lists nine rentable spaces with weekday and Saturday/Sunday/holiday fee blocks. The Event Hall is 190 m2 with 221 seats, or 130 persons as a flat-floor hall. Saturday/Sunday/holiday blocks are Morning 9:00-12:00 30,300 yen, Afternoon 13:00-17:00 44,200 yen, Night 18:00-21:00 36,500 yen, so a 09:00-17:00 day is 74,500 yen and a 09:00-21:00 day is 111,000 yen. The page states facilities cannot be used before 9:00 and after 21:00, extensions are limited to 30 minutes, and preparation and clearing time count inside the booked window. verification_questions: Confirm AV in the Event Hall for a 50-person talk plus projection: the English page sells equipment hire separately and does not list a projector or screen as included.
Confirm whether event Wi-Fi is provided in the Event Hall (the page advertises Wi-Fi in the Interaction Lobby, not in the rented rooms).
Confirm whether the published Saturday/Sunday/holiday rates are tax-inclusive; the English and Japanese pages print the same figures without a consumption-tax statement.
Confirm date availability through the online reservation system for a Saturday in 2027 (reservations open six months ahead, first day of the month).

Confirm the alcohol rule for the Event Hall: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the venue publishes no alcohol permission, and an in-house cafe's licence is not evidence that a rented hall may serve alcohol.

blockers.text: Cost is an estimate from a published rate, not a quote.

evidence.inference: One of the three 100-seat rooms matches the brief exactly, and the campus location is the strongest academic-audience draw in the set; the recorded cost is an hourly-times-hours estimate, not a quote, because eligibility and rate class for an external organiser are unresolved.
evidence.observed_facts: The Kyoto University Clock Tower fee page (fetched 2026-11-28) prints a per-hour schedule: 百周年記念ホール（大ホール）35,700 / 41,600 yen per hour, 国際交流ホール（1室あたり）9,500 / 10,700 yen per hour, 会議室 I and II 3,800 / 4,400, 会議室 III 6,600 / 7,900, 会議室 IV 6,000 / 7,200, with consumption tax included and part-hours rounded up to a full hour. The facility page for 国際交流ホール states a capacity of 300 seats in three divisible rooms of 100 each and opening hours of 09:00-21:30. The building's access page places it at Yoshida-honmachi, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: unknown — the clock tower's own access URL (https://www.kyoto-u.ac.jp/ja/about/facilities/campus/clocktower/access) returned HTTP 404 today, the university campus access page captured today carries maps without rail or walking text, and no captured page names a station or walking time for the clock tower, so the nearest station and walking time are carried as a location question.

names_seen: 京都大学 百周年時計台記念館 — 国際交流ホール I（2F）
verification_questions: Confirm eligibility: the facility page states rooms are available 'when the event matches the facility's purpose and permission is granted' (設置目的に添った行事等を行う場合、許可を得て), and the fee schedule distinguishes university-organised from other events by applying a half rate for specified categories, so an external community event's eligibility and rate class must be confirmed with the facility office before any cost is relied on.
Confirm AV: the hall page mentions screens and a lighting set for the building but does not itemise a projector for 国際交流ホール I, so projection must be confirmed.
Confirm Wi-Fi in the hall.

Confirm the 09:00-17:00 total: the fee schedule prices 国際交流ホール at 9,500 yen per hour (standard) or 10,700 yen per hour (holiday class) with part-hours rounded up, so 85,600 yen is eight hours at the holiday rate.
Confirm Saturday availability and the application deadline (applications are made to the facility office in advance).

Confirm the alcohol rule for 国際交流ホール I: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the university's facility and fee pages publish no alcohol rule for the hall.
Confirm the nearest station and walking time to the clock tower (the building's access URL returned HTTP 404 today and the captured campus access page carries maps without rail or walking text).

evidence.inference: At 72 claimed seats and 18,220 yen for the two day blocks, this is the cheapest 50-person-capable room in the package; the missing combined-rate row is why the cost is recorded as a published-block sum rather than a package price.
evidence.observed_facts: The Asny room page (fetched 2026-11-28) lists 第3研修室 at 72 seats with 午前 8,380 yen, 午後 9,840 yen and 夜間 11,200 yen, inside the centre's 09:00-21:00 opening hours with Tuesday closure. The page notes that the windows of 第2・第3・第4研修室 must not be opened during use, and that alcoholic drinks are prohibited on the premises. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: there is no station within walking distance — reach the centre from Nijo (二条) subway/JR station by city bus 15 or 52 to the 丸太町七本松 stop and about 400 m west on foot (official access map https://asny.ne.jp/asnymap.html, captured as captures/asny_accessmap.html). Alcohol: the page prohibits alcoholic drinks on the premises (アルコール飲料類は禁じております), so the alcohol/liquor-licence question is answered 'no' rather than left open.

verification_questions: Confirm whether the Special Conference Room includes a projector and screen, or whether they are hired as equipment (the page sells equipment separately).
Confirm event Wi-Fi in the Special Conference Room.
Confirm the tax treatment of the published Saturday/Sunday/holiday rate (69,800 yen for 09:00-17:00).
Confirm Saturday availability for 2027 through the online reservation system.

Confirm the alcohol rule for the Special Conference Room: whether serving alcohol at a private community event is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the venue publishes no alcohol permission, and an in-house cafe's licence is not evidence that a rented room may serve alcohol.

evidence.inference: Two independent facts matter for this brief: alcohol is explicitly prohibited (so the licensing question is answered 'no' rather than left open), and the 17:00-18:00 gap hour is priced separately, which means a true 12-hour booking costs more than the sum of the three blocks.
evidence.observed_facts: The Kyoto Asny room page (asny.ne.jp/room/, fetched 2026-11-28) lists 第2研修室 at 104 seats with blocks 11,200 / 13,930 / 16,760 yen, opening hours 09:00-21:00 (Sundays and public holidays until 17:00), Tuesday closure, and state the centre has begun providing Wi-Fi in the rented rooms (Wi-Fi環境利用申請書). The page prices a projector at 3,770 yen per set, a monitor at 2,510 yen, a microphone at 1,250 yen, and states that deliveries from outside the first-floor restaurant must be notified in advance and that alcoholic drinks are prohibited. The 17:00-18:00 hour is charged at two-fifths of the night block; outside-hours use is one third of the afternoon rate per hour. Address 9-2 Jurakumawari Matsushita-cho, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto 604-8401. USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: there is no station within walking distance — reach the centre from Nijo (二条) subway/JR station by city bus 15 or 52 to the 丸太町七本松 stop and about 400 m west on foot (official access map https://asny.ne.jp/asnymap.html, captured as captures/asny_accessmap.html). Alcohol: the page prohibits alcoholic drinks on the premises (アルコール飲料類は禁じております), so the alcohol/liquor-licence question is answered 'no' rather than left open.

verification_questions: Confirm the screen: the page prices a projector at 3,770 yen per set and a monitor at 2,510 yen per set but does not itemise a projection screen in the room.
Confirm Saturday availability and the provisional-reservation route (telephone or counter, from the first opening day six months ahead).
Confirm the total for 09:00-21:00 including the 17:00-18:00 hour charged at two-fifths of the night block (the recorded 25,130 yen covers only the 午前 and 午後 blocks).
Confirm that the room's windows must stay closed during events (the page requires it for 第2・第3・第4研修室) is acceptable for a summer event.

evidence.inference: This is the only hotel candidate with a published room rate for a 50-70 person seated layout and a stated 9:00-21:00 window; the recorded cost deliberately adds one overtime hour to the seven-hour special because the brief's window is eight hours, and that arithmetic is stated rather than presented as a printed package.
evidence.observed_facts: The Hotel Elcient Kyoto Hachijoguchi conference page (elcient.com/kyoto/conference, fetched 2026-11-28) lists Conference Room A (51 m2, 30 school / 24 hollow-square) and Conference Room B (127 m2, 72 school / 36 hollow-square, 60 seated for banquets, 80 standing), halls open 9:00-21:00, with Conference Room B at 65,000 yen for three hours, a 70,000-yen seven-hour special for Room A and 130,000 yen for Room B, overtime at 20,000 yen per hour for Room B, all tax-inclusive and including set-up. The equipment list includes マイク, プロジェクター, プロジェクター台, スクリーン and a Wi-Fi/LAN line; above 30 guests two microphones and a lectern are free. Address 13 Higashikujo Higashiyama-o-cho, Minami-ku, Kyoto 601-8004 (Hachijoguchi side of Kyoto Station). USD-equivalent conversion basis: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27, fetched 2026-11-28 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (EUR 1 = USD 1.0957; EUR 1 = JPY 174.81), giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and 1 JPY = USD 0.00626795; see fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md. Nearest station: JR Kyoto Station, Hachijo east exit, about 2 minutes on foot (the conference page's own site description reads 'JR京都駅 八条東口 徒歩2分', captured as captures/elcient_conference_jp.html).

verification_questions: Confirm the 09:00-17:00 total: the page prices Conference Room B at 65,000 yen for three hours, a 130,000 yen seven-hour special and 20,000 yen per overtime hour, so the recorded 150,000 yen is the seven-hour rate plus one overtime hour and is not a printed eight-hour package.

Confirm screen, projector and microphone provision for a 50-person talk (the page lists マイク, プロジェクター, プロジェクター台, スクリーン and Wi-Fi/LAN in its equipment list, with two microphones and a lectern free above 30 guests).
Confirm that outside catering is not permitted and price the in-house option if the event needs lunch (banquet menus start at 6,000 yen per person).
Confirm Saturday availability directly with the hotel sales office (the page carries a booking form, not a live calendar).

Confirm the alcohol rule for Conference Room B: whether serving alcohol at a private community event in the rented room is permitted, whether an event liquor licence is required and who must hold it — the hotel publishes no alcohol permission for the conference rooms, and the hotel bar or restaurant licence is not evidence that a rented hall may serve alcohol.
